evals.name: python-fastapi-full-integration
evals.prompt: Add Presto Pay to this FastAPI shop. There's an Order model in app/models.py with id, total_cents and status, and SQLAlchemy async sessions in app/db.py. I want a POST /checkout/{order_id} that sends the shopper to Presto, a return page, and the webhook. Presto gave us staging credentials, I'll put them in .env.
evals.expected_output: Uses AsyncPrestoPay from presto_pay, created once in the lifespan; init with integer amount and redirect to payment_url; return page and webhook both query and share one update function; webhook verifies the raw body, answers 401 on PrestoPaySignatureError, dedups on event_ref_num under a unique constraint, replies NotifyAck; credentials via env vars with .env.example; no hand-rolled signing.

assertions.text: Depends on presto-pay-sdk and imports from presto_pay
No hand-written RSA signing or canonical string code (no cryptography sign calls, no hashlib/sha256 of request fields)
Client is created once (lifespan or module singleton), not inside a request handler
Webhook passes the raw body (await request.body()) to webhooks.verify, not a parsed model or dict
Webhook returns 401 for PrestoPaySignatureError and HTTP 200 with a NotifyAck body otherwise
Webhook calls payments.query and does not derive the status from event_code or success
event_ref_num is deduplicated with a unique constraint or equivalent atomic insert
Return page calls payments.query and does not trust URL parameters for the status
amount is passed as an int of minor units
No private key, mid or prestoMrn value is hard-coded; variables are listed in .env.example and key files are git-ignored

evals.name: java-spring-refund-unknown-outcome
evals.prompt: In our Spring Boot back office (src/main/java/com/acme/admin), add a service method and an admin-only endpoint to refund a Presto Pay payment, full or partial. We already have a PrestoPayClient bean. Make sure a timeout can't refund someone twice.
evals.expected_output: Uses presto.payments().refund with PaymentRefundRequest builder, a stable refundRefNum stored before calling, remark set; on transport/response/signature exceptions or 5xx it queries first and checks refundDetails for the refundRefNum rather than retrying; endpoint secured to admins; amounts integer minor units.

assertions.text: Calls presto.payments().refund(PaymentRefundRequest.builder()...build())
refundRefNum is derived deterministically and persisted before the call
On an unknown outcome it queries and inspects refundDetails / refundStatus before any retry
Does not wrap refund in a generic retry loop or @Retryable
Endpoint is restricted to an admin role
Amount handled as integer minor units, not double

evals.name: go-webhook-raw-body-fix
evals.prompt: Our Presto webhook in internal/http/presto.go decodes the JSON into a struct with json.NewDecoder and then marks the order paid when EventCode == "Authorised". It sometimes double-ships. Fix it properly.
evals.expected_output: Replaces decoding with verifier.VerifyRequest(r) (or Verify on raw bytes), answers 401 on *prestopay.SignatureError, queries payment status with client.Payments.Query, dedups on EventRefNum under a unique constraint in the same transaction, fulfils only on the transition into Authorised, replies with prestopay.WriteAck.

assertions.text: Uses verifier.VerifyRequest(r) or verifier.Verify(rawBody)
Returns http.StatusUnauthorized for *prestopay.SignatureError
Calls client.Payments.Query and uses its PaymentStatus instead of EventCode
Deduplicates on EventRefNum atomically with the order update
Replies with prestopay.WriteAck using AckOK / AckResend appropriately
Explains the double-shipping cause (redelivery without dedup and/or trusting EventCode)

evals.name: js-nextjs-checkout
evals.prompt: set up presto pay checkout in our next.js app router project (app/ dir, prisma for the db, Order has id + amountCents). need the pay button server action, the return page and the webhook route. deploy target is vercel.
evals.expected_output: Installs @prestouniverse/presto-pay-sdk; client in a server-only module from fromEnv(process.env); server action calls init and redirect(paymentUrl); return page queries; app/.../route.ts POST passes the Request to webhooks.verify, 401 on PrestoPaySignatureError, NotifyAck responses, dedup on eventRefNum; no NEXT_PUBLIC_ secrets; no import in client components.

assertions.text: Imports @prestouniverse/presto-pay-sdk only from server-side files
No NEXT_PUBLIC_ variable holds Presto keys or ids
Webhook route passes the Request or raw text to webhooks.verify without calling request.json() first
Signature errors return 401 via isPrestoPayError + error.name check, not instanceof
Return page queries Presto for the status
eventRefNum dedup via a unique column in Prisma

evals.name: php-laravel-review
evals.prompt: We built our Presto Pay integration in Laravel ourselves before the SDK existed (app/Services/PrestoClient.php signs requests with openssl_sign). Review it and tell me what to change before go-live.
evals.expected_output: Recommends replacing the hand-rolled client with prestouniverse/presto-pay-sdk; walks the go-live checklist (status from query, raw-body webhook verification with 401, dedup, NotifyAck, init resend with same txnRefNum, query before retrying refund, env separation, key outside web root, CSRF exemption); findings ranked by money impact with file references.

assertions.text: Recommends replacing hand-rolled openssl_sign signing with the official SDK
Checks that order status comes from query, not the redirect or webhook fields
Checks webhook raw-body verification, 401 on bad signature, eventRefNum dedup and NotifyAck replies
Checks key storage outside the web root / source control and staging/production separation
Findings are ranked by impact and reference files
